sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant is present.
In spite of service of notice, respondent did not turn up and remained ex-parte.

2. Heard arguments of learned counsel for the appellant.
3.

This transfer petition is filed by petitioner-wife for transfer of MC.No.74/2023 filed by respondent-husband for divorce before the Senior Civil Judge and J.M.F.C., Channapatna,
Ramanagara District to the Family Court, Bengaluru.

4. It is stated that the petitioner-wife filed complaint in Crime No.67/2024 under Section 498A of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 within the jurisdiction of the Bengaluru Courts.

The respondent-husband is also working as FDA in Karnataka Bhovi Development Corporation, Bengaluru, as he is native of Channapatna, he filed divorce petition before the Channapatna Court only to harass her.
The NC: 2026:KHC:6586 HC-KAR distance between Channapatna and Bengaluru is 57 kilometers.
Their marriage was performed on 25.05.2022 and they are not blessed with children.

5. Considering the reasons stated by the learned counsel for the petitioner and the fact that respondent is also working in Bengaluru, this court finds it reasonable to transfer MC.No.74/2023 from the Senior Civil Judge and J.M.F.C., Channapatna, Ramanagara District to the Family Court,
Bengaluru.
6. In the result, the petition is allowed.
